maps.title: 行动前训练

dialogue.speaker: Andy
dialogue.text: 先确认移动、切换武器、射击和换弹的操作。按键沿用你当前的设置，可在设置里查看。

dialogue.speaker: Andy
dialogue.text: 开局会随机赠送一把普通星座武器。初始配给到账后，打开装备界面的背包，使用“61计划初始主枪自选箱”选择主枪，再装入长枪栏。药品可放入药剂栏，材料与多余物资可在整备中查看。

dialogue.speaker: Andy
dialogue.text: 熟悉操作后从右侧大门离开。门外就是A01第一现场，第一场战斗在那里开始。

Event.Message: 61计划训练：先在装备界面的背包打开初始主枪自选箱，选择并装备主枪。随机星座武器和配给已直接入包；确认药弹后从右侧大门进入A01。
训练结束，右侧大门已经开放。走出去即进入A01第一现场，战斗教学由第一战承担。

lootPolicy.gate: one frozen DropLuckRoller PRD decision per identity; existing inverse-skill bonus
lootPolicy.categorySelection: filter categories against remaining caps and captured equipment before the one gate; on hit make one weighted choice
lootPolicy.ammo: one ordinary paid full reload for each delivered real weapon and its installed subweapon; exact inventory costs summed by name
lootPolicy.delivery: Durably admit complete equipment to unique reward-stash entries, render those exact entries as ground weapons, and use the existing stash take/query transaction for pickup. Ammo prefers inventory in the same admission; overflow and unpicked weapons remain in reward stash. Never reconstruct equipment from a numeric pickup quantity.
lootPolicy.limits: First weapon by the eighth eligible fixed-soldier death when a valid primary/ammo packet exists; old decisions are immutable and an old run already past the threshold qualifies on its next new eligible death. No replacement for cancelled identities; no new shops or pools. Rates are candidate package settings, not final economic acceptance.

firstWeaponGuarantee.scope: first real weapon in this run; one frozen current identity, same quotas
firstWeaponGuarantee.prd: Perform the normal gate exactly once; retain its natural PRD advancement even when the guarantee replaces the category. Never rewrite a prior decision.

groundWeapons.recovery: unpicked equipment remains durable and may reappear on its original map; legacy packets are not regranted
groundWeapons.atomicity: one exact stash take/query operation per equipment entry; unknown outcome holds the entity and pause until reconciliation
